How it works

Three steps to the altar

  1. Pick what you wantAdd ranks or hats to your basket. You can buy for a friend too.
  2. Enter your Minecraft nameExactly as it is in game. That's who gets it.
  3. Pay securely through TebexCard or PayPal. Ranks apply within a minute. Hats arrive the next time you're online, straight into your inventory.

Fair play promise. Nothing on this store helps you in PvP. Flight only works inside your own claim and switches off the moment you're hit. Homes and ender chest are blocked after combat and while captured.
